meta.note: Colour, type scale, spacing, radii, shadows, breakpoints and the 75–450ms motion range measured from a live marketing site. Easing curves, dur-draw, dur-pulse and dur-float are this system's additions.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Almost every section sits on it; sections are separated by space, not colour.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Soft panels (a sign-up block) and the outline button's fill.

tokens.name: surface-strong
tokens.usage: Tag fills and medium-emphasis wells.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Row and menu-item hover wash.

tokens.name: surface-band
tokens.usage: The one full-bleed dark band per page, corners radius-xl.

tokens.name: surface-band-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and inactive pill tabs sitting on surface-band.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Headlines, card titles, labels on surface, surface-subtle and surface-strong (17:1+ light, 16:1+ dark).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy on surface and surface-subtle (10.8:1 light).

tokens.name: text-weak
tokens.usage: Meta labels, captions and legal lines on surface, surface-subtle and surface-strong (4.6:1 minimum light, 5:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-lede
tokens.usage: The hero subhead under the display headline, on surface only.

tokens.name: text-on-band
tokens.usage: Headings and copy on surface-band and surface-band-raised (10.8:1+).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on any pastel fill (orchid, highlighter, mint, sky, blush, lilac) in both themes; 13:1+.

tokens.name: border-weak
tokens.usage: Dividers inside cards, menus and lists. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: 1px outline of white cards and callouts. Decorative: the card is also set apart by its content.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Text-field outline. 1.6:1 on surface, below the 3:1 control-border floor; kept from the source, so always pair fields with a visible label and the adjacent button. Accessible alternative: border-strong.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Field and outline-button border on hover.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outline button border; 5.1:1 on surface. Use it for field outlines where contrast matters more than lightness.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: UI icons on surface.

tokens.name: icon-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled icons.

tokens.name: button-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary pill fill on hover; dark theme flips to coral.

tokens.name: on-button-primary

tokens.name: button-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary pill fill.

tokens.name: button-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary pill fill on hover; label switches to on-button-secondary-hover.

tokens.name: on-button-secondary
tokens.usage: Label and 1px outline of the secondary pill.

tokens.name: on-button-secondary-hover
tokens.usage: Secondary pill label on hover (5.1:1+).

tokens.name: button-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled pill fill. Its label pair is 2.7:1; disabled controls are exempt, but never use it for anything enabled.

tokens.name: on-button-disabled
tokens.usage: Label on button-disabled.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on surface; underline on hover in light.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover colour (in light the underline does the work).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The mark colour: the dot in a wordmark, dark-theme hovers, one node in a graph. Sparingly; never body text on white (3.0:1).

tokens.name: gradient-red

tokens.name: gradient-pink
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the headline gradient. 2.3:1 on white alone; only ever inside the red-pink-red gradient on display text, never solo text.

tokens.name: orchid

tokens.name: highlighter

tokens.name: highlighter-deep
tokens.usage: Deep chartreuse for illustration accents only.

tokens.name: mint

tokens.name: sky

tokens.name: sky-deep

tokens.name: blush

tokens.name: blush-deep
tokens.usage: Deep berry for marks and icons on blush (6.4:1).

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Lilac label fill. Text: on-accent.

tokens.name: lilac-deep
tokens.usage: Deep purple for marks and icons on lilac (5.3:1).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surface (7.1:1 light). Same value in dark, where it is 2.3:1: there, always pair it with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface (7.4:1 light; 2.2:1 dark: add icon and word).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text on surface (7.4:1 light; 2.2:1 dark: add icon and word). Close to error in lightness, so always carry a word or icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px outline, 2px offset. 2.7:1 on white, below 3:1 (kept from the source); 6.1:1 on the dark surface. Accessible alternative on white: a text-strong ring.
